acceptance: UI-only interaction benchmark includes 1k-row view and memory-growth probes; source/network delays reported separately.

positive.fixture: 1,000-row grid: write counts, focus stability, memory growth and source-independent timing

negative.fixture: normal, error, empty, unknown, conflicted and disabled states across schemes match the golden contract

performance_memory_storage: Medians of 5 runs, 1,000 rows: render 90 ms, filter 4 ms, one cell update 1 write, sort 12 ms, 84 KB heap growth over 30 churn cycles, 0 DOM and 0 subscription growth; a 300 ms source delay is reported separately (bench/ui.json).
known_limitations: Visual regression is a computed-style and ARIA contract, not pixel comparison
